slug: 2025-06-23 Libya's PM Dabaiba approves Unified Social Registry project

facts.fact: LANA reports that on 23 June 2025 Prime Minister Dabaiba approved the draft Unified Social Registry document, a project relying on a unified database of citizens' social and economic information to identify those eligible for support.

LANA reports that on 22 June 2025 Prime Minister Dabaiba approved the draft Unified Social Registry document, built on a unified database of citizens' social and economic information with a classification system by income, health status and family size and periodic data updates.
UNICEF Libya announced that the Tripoli-based government, with UN agencies, has launched the Unified Social Registry to identify and target those in need for social protection programmes.

note: A single database is only an aim of the ministry's plan; no registry is stated as built or in service.

Names no social registry; the link is for one grant programme.

facts.fact: Libya's Minister of Social Affairs reviewed implementation of the unified social registry project with its oversight committee, formed by a 2024 prime-minister decision, and the steps to complete the registry system (Libyan News Agency).

note: Prime Minister approved a draft registry document; an approval, not a registry procured, piloted or populated.
Higher committee only tasked a team to draft the final project document; a plan, nothing built.
Document says nothing about a social registry.
